Repository: platform
What the code contains: `platform` is a Python project with 308 module(s), 81 HTTP endpoint(s), a command line (`backend/src/hmap/agents/docgen/compile_report.py`, `backend/src/hmap/core/runtime/host.py`, `infra/observability/load/soak.py`) and 109 test file(s). Its main parts are `env`, `hmap`, `build_dashboard`, `soak`, `cloud_check`, `demo_chaos`, `demo_preflight`, `demo_sprint_1`.
Summary of the code: The platform is a hierarchical multi‑agent AI execution system (hmap) that orchestrates document ingestion, analysis, planning, refinement, research, coding and testing through a set of plug‑in agents. Core configuration and error handling live in `backend/src/hmap/core/config.py` and `backend/src/hmap/core/errors.py`, while the FastAPI entry point `backend/src/hmap/api/app.py` exposes the HTTP endpoints that drive the agents. Each agent implements a contract defined in the core contracts package (e.g., `backend/src/hmap/core/contracts/domain.py`) and registers its capabilities via `backend/src/hmap/core/plugins.py` and runtime discovery (`backend/src/hmap/core/runtime/discovery.py`). Supporting services such as in‑memory stores (`backend/src/hmap/services/artifact/memory.py`, `backend/src/hmap/services/context/memory.py`) and tracing (`backend/src/hmap/core/tracing.py`) provide persistence, observability and tracing across the pipeline. The repository also includes command‑line tools for building dashboards, running soak tests and generating documentation, tying together the various demo and sprint components into a cohesive AI workflow.
